data.title: 莲华 · 猩红床幔里的颠倒众生
data.description: 垂挂着重重猩红纱幔的闺房深处，薄如蝉翼的睡裙早已遮掩不住凝脂般的肌肤。莲华反客为主地跨坐上来，双手按住对方的胸口，在炽热的占有中仰头吐出带着颤音的娇吟。

data.action: straddling partner firmly on luxury bed in sheer crimson babydoll, hands pressed to his chest, arching back in fierce intoxicated dominance
data.lighting: flickering beeswax candles casting deep scarlet shadows through translucent canopy gauze
data.mood: dominant feminine seduction, intoxicating crimson eroticism, overwhelming sensual authority
